purpose: Sign-specific two-part Calendar cards composed from the owner-approved meaning components. Each card carries a forecast the reader can use and a Details explanation underneath.
servingRule: Both ownerApproved and servingAuthorized must be true. Anything else is invisible to the runtime and the Calendar falls through to the existing exact body for that planet pair and aspect.
storedBodyConvention: forecast begins lowercase; the Calendar composes the date lead-in. details begins with the transit label, for example 'Sun in Leo opposite Saturn in Aquarius.'
